name: FFA Abbasid , by a noob 4 noobs
author: Azur

notes: @resource/berrybush.webp@4 on Berries.
@building_economy/house.png@ 1 to build House, then Berries @resource/berrybush.png@.
@landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ 1 build Landmark, then Berries@resource/berrybush.png@.
@building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ 2 on Gold.
@unit_cavalry/scout.png@ make sure to scout as much as you can. Especially your neighbours and the center.
@resource/berrybush.webp@ 4 on Berries.
@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ 2 on Wood.
@age/age_2.png@ Age up in ECO in House of Wisdom@landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ -> @landmark_abbasid/economic-wing.png@.
NOTE: Make sure you don't have unneccessary villagers Q'd up, preventing you from ageing up around this time.
Don't forget to always keep at least 1 villager Q'd up in you TC, during your age up.
NOW:
> Adjust your Eco as soon as you click up.
Take 8x @resource/resource_food.webp@ from Berries @resource/berrybush.png@ -> @resource/resource_wood.png@ wood to@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ around your TC.
@resource/rally.png@next 2 vils on Berries @resource/berrybush.png@.
> Take 5 vil's on straggler trees. Build a @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@mining camp on stone@resource/resource_stone.png@, as soon you have the wood.
NOTE:
You need to wait until you can effort it.
Collect stone @resource/resource_stone.png@, until you have 460. (Enough for 2 TC's in Feudal, with your unique Tech in House of Wisdom)
Keep Rallying @resource/rally.webp@  X Villagers on Wood@resource/resource_wood.png@, until you can effort your first and second TC.
Build a  lumber camp@building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ with one willager from the straggler trees, already collecting wood.
Adjust:
> Use 5 Villagers from Wood @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to place you first TC@building_economy/town-center.png@ on a ressource you want to secure.
> Use 5 Villagers from Stone @resource/resource_stone.png@ to place your second TC @building_economy/town-center.png@.
> Switch Rally point @resource/rally.png@ from Home TC to food@resource/resource_food.png@.

> At this point you are wide open and slightly vulnerable, but don't worry to much if you lose something, since most people are on one TC. You are on 3 TC's easily effording production on all of them.
>NOTE if you are being attacked:

Wood is really important for you defending possible attacks and repairing your buildings, building towers or building a single barracks nearby, secondly food to keep your villager production running and producing spearman.
> Make sure you always kept scouting your opponents. or you have at least vision towards them (Tower or 1 scout).
Therefore you can react to possible attacks.
> Get an equal amount of Villager numbers on Food, Wood and Gold.
> In general effort at least one Barracks to defend yourself, until Castle.
> Produce some Spearman to defend yourself 6x @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, until you reach castle.
> Get melee upgrades in Forge @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ and Barracks @building_military/barracks.png@. - Otherwise your units are low quality paper

I think you can choose between millitary wing@landmark_abbasid/military-wing.webp@ or culture wing@landmark_abbasid/culture-wing.png@. Since you have a lot of open upgrades at this point, i think culture Wing might boost you, getting everything in castle much easier and therefore faster@technology_abbasid/preservation-of-knowledge.png@. Your advancing to Imperial age becomes cheaper too.
> Again: Effort more than just a single forge@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@, otherwise your techs will take so much time and your army is going to be paper.
> Get all your melee millitary upgrades first and then your eco upgrades.
> You want to FIGHT now.
> Get Information on the map, Map control and Fight. @unit_cavalry/scout.png@@building_defensive/outpost.png@
> Age up as soon as you can to Imperial.
keep getting Information on the map, Map control and Fight. @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@@building_defensive/outpost.png@
Important Note:

In Imperial Age @age/age_4.webp@and in your House of Wisdom @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@. Make sure you get get the unique Tech for your infantry of your Military Wing@landmark_abbasid/military-wing.png@->@technology_abbasid/camel-support.png@. As well as all the other Melee upgrades in@landmark_abbasid/military-wing.png@ ->@technology_abbasid/boot-camp.png@and
in @building_technology/madrasa.png@->@technology_military/elite-army-tactics.png@.

description: just boom quick enough and pray for the best.
